items.question: Which natural items are likewise included in this enumerated context?
premises: A tree leaf is included as an item.
Tulasī and dhātrī are named as specific plants.
Tree fruit is included in the same manner.
items.inference: The enumeration extends to leaves, tulasī, dhātrī, and tree fruits as comparable items.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of these items depends on the following verse or broader context.
Whether these are offerings, materials, or examples is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And a tree leaf, tulasī, dhātrī, and likewise a tree fruit.
